name: Roll Angle out of Bounds
hint: A roll comparison outside -90° to 90° describes an impossible orientation, so roll-dependent behaviour can become unreliable.
instruction: Constrain roll readings and thresholds to the inclusive -90° through 90° range before comparing them.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB roll angle° :: sensing) > (100)> then
say [Invalid roll]
end
